class ExpiryPolicy(Enum):
    """Enum representing different expiry policies for cache entries."""
    TTL = "ttl"          # Time-to-live based expiry
    TTI = "tti"          # Time-to-idle based expiry
    NONE = "none"        # No expiry


@dataclass
class CacheEntry:
    """
    Represents a single entry in the cache.
    
    Attributes:
        key: The hashable key for the cache entry.
        value: The value stored in the cache.
        created_at: Timestamp when the entry was created.
        last_accessed: Timestamp when the entry was last accessed.
        expires_at: Timestamp when the entry expires (None if no expiry).
        policy: The expiry policy used for this entry.
    """
    key: Hashable
    value: Any
    created_at: float
    last_accessed: float
    expires_at: Optional[float] = None
    policy: ExpiryPolicy = ExpiryPolicy.NONE
    
    def is_expired(self, now: Optional[float] = None) -> bool:
        """Check if this entry has expired."""
        if self.expires_at is None:
            return False
        if now is None:
            now = time.time()
        return now >= self.expires_at
    
    def touch(self, now: Optional[float] = None) -> None:
        """Update the last accessed timestamp."""
        if now is None:
            now = time.time()
        self.last_accessed = now
        # If using TTI policy, update expiry based on last access
        if self.policy == ExpiryPolicy.TTI and self.expires_at is not None:
            # Recalculate expiry from last access
            ttl = self.expires_at - self.last_accessed
            self.expires_at = now + ttl

This module implements:

2. A thread-safe wrapper around the LRU cache

import time

from collections import OrderedDict

        last_accessed: Timestamp when the entry was last accessed

    """

    value: Any
    created_at: float
    last_accessed: float
    ttl: Optional[float] = None
    
    def is_expired(self, now: Optional[float] = None) -> bool:
        """
        Check if this entry has expired.
        
        Args:
